title: Fifth Amendment, Office Lease - Sparknight, LLC - Central Administrative Offices - 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Fifth Amendment, Lease Agreement by and between the Oakland Unified School District (“District) as lessee, and Sparknight, LLC, a Florida limited liability company, as lessor (“Lessor”), for space within the building located at 1000 Broadway, Oakland, CA 94607, commonly known as the Transpacific Centre, in which the  District and Lessor propose to: (1) further extend the termination date of the Original Lease, as amended, by one year to August 31, 2023; (2) reduce the premises rented by the District from Lessor by calling for the District to surrender Suite 300 back to the Lessor; (3) establish the amount of monthly base rent to be owed by the District to the Lessor; (4) describe the District’s and Lessor’s rights and obligations with regard to certain move‐out and close‐out procedures to be performed by District with regard to Suite 300; (5) grant the District the option to extend the termination date of the Lease by one additional period of six months; and (6) modify the rights of the District to parking at the Property, for $2,501,550.00 total annual rent under the Fifth Amendment, for the term of September 1, 2022 through August 31, 2023.
headline: Extends the district's Broadway office lease one year at $2.5M a year and gives up Suite 300
summary: This fifth amendment to the lease for the central administrative offices at 1000 Broadway extends the lease by one year to August 31, 2023. The district will give Suite 300 back to the landlord, Sparknight, LLC, and a new monthly base rent is set. The district also gets an option to extend six more months, and its parking rights change. Total annual rent is $2,501,550.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
